title: THE ARMY
headlines: Every man doubles his hit by level 10, then the climb tapers: x2.55 at 20, x3.10 at 50, x3.47 at 100. The heroes climb on their own lane (x1.49 at 100).
At level 100 the SERVICE PISTOL lands the most on one man (173.5 a second); the SNIPER RIFLE hits hardest a blow (83.2, 166.3 on a crit).
Sarge's crit odds: 5 % at level 10, 10 % at 15, 18 % at 100; a crit lands x2.
HP at level 100: FLAME 110 down to MEDIC 40; in the campaign and every boss fight an enemy's blow lands at 50 % (the damper).
Every gun fires its listed rate since v29.24 (the fire clock carries a frame's leftover): the pistol 11.41 rounds a second at level 100 (measured 11.41), where it stopped at 10 from level 29 before.
rule: A man's level runs 0 to 100. The first 10 levels pay in full, then the gains taper (they never stop): the ladder's units are 10.0 at level 10, 15.5 at 20, 21.0 at 50 and 24.7 at 100.

THE HIT: a man's blow is his class's hit x (1 + 0.1 x the units): x2.00 at level 10 and x3.47 at 100. A hero's own lane is (1 + 0.02 x the units); King Yeti's sword climbs on the men's lane, King Rex bites twice.

SARGE: each iron has its own track and its own formula (the look page SARGE'S IRONS has every number). The pistol adds 1 to every round for each ten pistol levels and doubles its rate at 10 and 20; his crit odds follow a line of their own.

HP is the unit sheet's: every class reaches its own number at level 100 (the book), climbs a rung every tenth level, and six classes carry extra HP every ten levels on top. THE BAR is the campaign's count of bar hits a man stands before he goes down.

In the campaign and every boss fight an enemy's blow lands at 50 % of its size (the damper, since v29.17; the battleground 70 %), and a bar hit lands x the share (0.9 + 0.1 x bar / HP): a stronger man takes a little less of each.

PER SECOND is one man's blows on one target: since v29.24 the fire clock carries a frame's leftover between shots, so every gun fires its listed rate on any screen (measured: the pistol 11.41 a second at level 100 for 11.41 listed).
notes: ARM-Q1 answered (Wyatt 11/2: 'Q1- yes. proceed.'): the six fights re-read on v29.23, v29.24 and v29.25 with the damper; their WHO SURVIVES tables count it.

ARM-Q2 answered (Wyatt 11/2: 'q2 yes. finish'): since v29.24 the fire clock carries a frame's leftover, so every gun fires its listed rate (measured here: the pistol 11.41 a second at level 100 for 11.41 listed).

Read on HEAD's client on Chrome for Testing and WebKit: the two reads are byte-identical. Each man, Sarge on each iron and each hero was placed at every level 0 to 100 inside a Boss Lab fight and read with the game's own readers.

Measured: one of ours at a time before one tan rifleman held unkillable and silent; every blow was caught as the HP he lost each frame (a rocket's, a bomb's and a grenade's burst take it off his HP directly). Every measured blow equals the read.

The heroes' blows are their own: King Yeti swings his sword (6 x the men's ladder), King Rex bites twice, King Croak's tongue climbs on a lane of its own (measured at every level). From about level 30 Emperor Bear's shells, and later his guard, do most of his fighting; his own blow is the shared formula's.
